tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos rjes mdzad pa'i bde mchog dril bu pa'i mngon rtogs bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo bde mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la/ chos la/ dge 'dun la'o/ /'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o/ /rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de 'od du zhu yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par bstim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbacom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'i rnam pas rkang pa'i mthe bong nas 'dzags/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha dri ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karmāḥsu tsa me/ tsittaṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan/ he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yi/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa/ sgrib pa/ nyes pa ltung ba grib ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ padma dang nyi zla'i steng na 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan par gyur pa sku'i dga' ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shrī he ru ka a haṃ/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu tshogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /don de dang ldan pa ni bdag nyid do/ ngag sngags su byin gyis brlab pa gsung gi dga' ba/ snying gi nang du a rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes las byung ba zla ba dag pa/ 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'i steng du hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu bya ba grub pa/ khog pa so sor rtogs pa/ mgo bo mnyam pa nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ sems ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa thugs kyi dga' ba/

de las 'od 'phros rang gi sdig pa thams cad dag ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sku lus la lha drug cu rtsa gnyis gnas pa'i spyi bor bla ma bzhugs pa spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥshrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇḍa le bhyaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ pā tyaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ dzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/ badzra shapda āḥhūm̐/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang / bdag gi mos pa dang / smon lam dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gis/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a brta ya/ a brta ya ho/ na maḥs manta budhā nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye/ spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharmāḥdhā tu ā kā sha/ sa manta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta pa ri sho dha ye/ maṇḍa le/ ma ma pra ṇi te pū n+ya dzñā na ba len sarba ta thā ga ta ba len na bandha/ swasd+ya ba len na tsa ye swāhā/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyis/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis brlabs nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor de dag rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis/

rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib logs rdo rje'i ra ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ skra sen ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor/ rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ka sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ka nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re khā'i rtsig pa/ rna ba rta babs/ sna rin chen pha gu/ so drwa ba dang / drwa ba phyed pa/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad de/ rten gyi gzhal yas khang / snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba'i hūm̐ nang gi he ru kar gnas pa dang / lus kyi phyi'i dbyibs/ phyi'i he ru kar gnas pa ni/ padma dang nyi zla'i steng du/ 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo bltab nas mnan pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo ba/ g.yon ljang ba/ rgyab dmar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing / 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon gos su gyon pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra satwa/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang / g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba/ 'tshogs ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal chen gyi rgya ste/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan zhing / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa 'o/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur bsdigs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing / byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba'o/ /snang ba dang / thabs dang / lhag mthong dang / snying rje chen po'i ngo bo ni/ yab yin la/ stong pa dang / shes rab dang / zhi gnas dang / bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing / zung du 'jug pa'i phyir kun tu kha sbyor ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /snying ka'i phyogs bzhir g.yon skor gyis/ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐ gnas pa/ rim pa bzhin/ mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ lā ma ljang khu/ khaṇa ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ gzugs can ma ser mo rnams/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang pas gnas pa/ mtshams rnams na bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa rnams bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur pa ni bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o/ /spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ pū dza oṃ a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gri sau su na si ma ku/ khams dang bcas pa rnams dpa' bo dang / dpa' mo rnams su gyur pa ni/ spyi bo pū li ra ma la yar/ khaṇa ḍa ka pā li dang / rab tu gtum mo'o/

/spyi gtsug dzā lan dha rar/ mahā kaṃ ka la dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa oṃ ḍi ya nar/ kaṃ ka la dang / 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa ar bu tar/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma ste gnas/ rna ba g.yon pa go da wa rir/ su ra bi ri dang / brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus ra me shwa rir/ 'od dpag med dang / mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wi ko ḍar/ rdo rje'i 'od dang / laṃ ka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la war/ rdo rje'i sku dang / shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa'o/ /mchan khung gnyis/ ka ma ru bar/ oṃ ku ri dang / ai rā ba ti/ nu ma gnyis o ṭer/ rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing / lte ba tri sha ku ner/ dpa' bo chen po dang / rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing / kha ka liṃ kar/ rab tu bzang mo dang / shyā ma de wi/ mgrin pa laṃ pa kar/ rdo rje bzang po dang / shin tu bzang mo ste tshan dho/ snying kan dzir/ 'jigs byed chen mo dang / rta rna ma/ 'doms bar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang / bya gdong ma ste nye ba'i tshan dho rnams gsung gi 'khor lo sku mdog dmar po sa la spyod pa'o/ /mtshan ma pre ta pu rir/ stobs po che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam gṛ ha de war/ rin chen rdo rje dang / khaṇa ḍa ro hi ste 'du ba/ brla gnyis sau rāṣṭ+rar rta mgrin dang / shoṇḍi ni/ byin pa gnyis su warṇa dwī bar/ nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo bcu drug na ga rar/ dpal he ru ka dang / shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong sindhur padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs chen ma ste dur khrod do/ /mthe bong bzhi ma rur/ rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor los sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ka lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod rnams sku'i 'khor lo sku mdog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/

/thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dpa' bo rnams rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing / rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun pa/ rnal 'byor ma rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs rdo rje phag mo lta bu'o/ /snying ka'i phyi skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ hūm̐ ring po brgyad gnas pa sgo mtshams ma rnams su gyur pa ni/ shar du khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser ba lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang / g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang ro'i gdan la drag mo'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /phyag mtshan dang cha lugs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lta bu/ lha thams cad gcer bu skra grol ba/ spyan gsum pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa ste/ bdag gi blo la snang ba'i lha sum cu so bdun po 'di dag byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun po yang / lha sum cu so bdun gyi ngo bo rnam par dag pa'o/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa atma ko haṃ/ bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang / 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku rnams dang / 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams dbyer med par gyur nas/ gnyis su med pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin/ oṃ badzra shuddha sarba dharm+maḥbadzra shuddhohaṃ/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa bdag yin/ yab kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la/ snying kar oṃ ha/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi/

rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hu/ padma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis la bau ṣaṭa he/ dpal he ru ka nag po/ mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ haṃ/ rta mchog ljang khu/ yum gyi lte bar/ oṃ baṃ/ rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying kar haṃ yoṃ/ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ khar hriṃ moṃ/ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hriṃ/ skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ/ tsaṇḍi ka dud kha ste/ thams cad kyang gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi gnas su yum/ yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med pa/ phaiṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇḍa la tsakra/ sarba bī ra yo gi ni ārghaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho haṃ/ phaiṃ mdun gyi nam mkha' dbang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo dang / khro mo dang / mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a bhi ṣekta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ bkra shis kyi glu dang / bgegs skrod pa dang / mchod pa mdzad pas ye shes kyi chus lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ gtso bo yab yum la rdo rje sems dpa'/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo la rnam par snang mdzad/

dam tshig gi 'khor lo la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa ste/ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan badzra rā dza huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharm+maḥswa bhā wa shuddhohaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i steng du/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che bar/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ dbus su go las ba lang gi sha/ shar du ku las khyi'i sha/ byang du da las rta'i sha/ nub tu ha las glang po che'i sha/ lhor na las mi'i sha/ de'i steng gi dbus su bi las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang sems/ nub tu ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ lhor ra las rakta/ de'i steng gi dbus su hūm̐ las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bhruṃ las me long lta bu/ byang du khaṃ las bya ba grub pa/ nub tu dzriṃ las so sor rtogs pa/ lhor aṃ las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo bo mthur du blta ba/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas/ rlung g.yos me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu zhing / khol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas bskul nas/ oṃ dang zla ba dang sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las/ bdud rtsi babs shing 'od zer rlangs pa dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs sna tshogs rdo rje la thim/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba dang oṃ dang bcas pa rnams thod par babs pas/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

de bzhin du yab yum dang / lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐/ pū/ dza/ au/ a/ gau/ ra/ de ma/ ka/ o/ tri/ ko/ ka/ la/ ka/ hi/ pre/ gri/ sau/ su/ na/ si/ ma/ ku/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swa hā hu/ bau khaṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭ haṃ/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yau/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hriḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ lha thams cad kyis snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas mnyes/ yid byung gi mchod pas sngar bzhin mchod la/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi sogs/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā kalpa ag ni san ni bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ṭā mu ku ṭota ka ṭa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṃṣṭ+ra ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pa sho dya ta shū la kha ṭwāṃ ga dhā ri ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ byā ghra dzi nāṃ ba ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā dhū mra an dha ka ra wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badzra bā rā hi baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo ārya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya ma ste mahā bidye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ nā maḥsarba bhu ta bha ya ba te mahā badzre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badzra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba shaṃ ka ri ne tra bhra ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na moḥbhi ṣa ṇi sho ṣa ni ro ṣa ni kro dha ni ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi su pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo dza ye bi dza ye dzaṃ bha ni staṃ bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badzra bā rā hi mahā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rtag tu snying la gnas pa yi/ /thig le gcig la 'gyur med pa/ /de bsgom byed pa'i skye bo la/

/nges par ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /snying kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sran ma bkas pa tsam gyi steng du/ byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le yungs 'bru tsam/ bzlas pa ni oṃ na mo bha ga wā te wī re shā ya mahā kalpa ag ni saṃ bha ni bhā ya/ dza ṭā mu ku ṭota ka ṭā ya/ daṃṣṭ+ra ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu ṣā ya/ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su ra ya/ pa ra shu pā sho dya ta shū la kha ṭwāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe/ byā ghra dzi nāṃ/ ba ra dha rā ya/ mahā dhā mra an dha kā rā wa pu ṣā ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban dha ban dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥphai ཾphai ཾ/ phaṭ phaṭ/ da had ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhakṣa bhakṣa/ ba sa ru dhi rān tra mā lā ba liṃ bi ne/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ sapta pā tā la ga ta bhu dza ga sarba bā tardza ya/ tardza ya/ ā kardha ā kardha/ hriṃ hriṃ/ dzñauṃ dzñauṃ/ kṣ+māṃ kṣ+māṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra swāhā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti badzra bā rā hi baṃ ārya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya ma te mahā bidye shwa rī/ sarba bhū ta bha yā ba he mahā badzre/ badzra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te/ ba shyaṃ ka ri ne tra bhra ma ṇi/ sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ni kro dha ni ka rā li na/ trā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye dzaṃ bha ni staṃ bha ni mo ha ni/ badzra bā rā hi mahā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge tadya thā/ pro taṃ ge pro taṃ ge ha na ha na/ prā ṇan/ kiṃ ki ni/ khiṃ khi ni/ dhu na dhu na/ badzra haste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badzra kha ṭwāṃ ga ka pā la dhā ri ṇi/ mahā pi si ta māṃ sā sha ni/ ma nu ṣyā ant+ra pra bi ste/ san ni dhyaṃ na ra shi ro/ mā lā gra thi ta/ dhā ri ṇi/ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha/

ha na ha na/ prā ṇan/ sarba pā paṃ satwā nāṃ/ mahā māṃ sa tstshe da naṃ kro dha murte/ daṃṣṭ+ra ka rā li ni mahā mu dre shrī he ru ka de ba sya gra ma hi ṣi/ sa ha sra shi re/ sa ha sra bā ha be/ sha ta sa ha srā a na ne/ dzwa li ta te dza se/ dzwa la mu khe/ piṃ ga la lo tsa ne/ badzri shwa rī ra/ badzra ā sa ne/ mi le te/ tsi li te/ he he/ huṃ hūm̐/ kha kha/ dhu dhu/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ muñtsa muñtsa/ a dwai temhā yo gi ni/ pi thi ta siddhi/ drai ཾdhaṃ draiṃ dhaṃ/ graṃ graṃ/ he he/ ha ha/ bhī me/ hā sa hā sa/ hā hā/ hoḥhoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐/ trai lokya bi nā sha ni/ sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta pa ri wā re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ siṃ ha ru pe kha ga dza ru pe ga trai lokya u da ri/ sa mu tra me kha le/ gra sa gra sa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bī rā dwai te huṃ hūm̐ hā hā/ mahā pa shu mo ha ni/ mahā yo gī shwa rī twaṃ/ ḍā ki nī/ lo kā nī/ ban dha ni sa tya ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bhū ta trā sa ni/ mahā bī re pa ra ma sid dhe yo gī shwa ri phaṭ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ sarba bud dhā ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ tsau ri ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ḍā kī nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā ma ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ru pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ka ra ka ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra tsaṇa ḍe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ku ru ku ru huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsaṇḍa kṣi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ban dha ban dha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra bha wa ti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tra sa ya tra sa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā nā se huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bī ra ma tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kharba rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ phaiṃ phai ཾhuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dru matstsha ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ phaṭ phaṭ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ai rā ba tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ da ha da ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā bhai ra be yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bā yu be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ba sa ru dhi ri and+ra mā lā ba liṃ bi ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sū rā bhikṣa ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sapta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṃ ga sarbaṃ bā tardza ya tardza ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shyā ma de wī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā kaḍhya ā kaḍhya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ subha trī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ha ya karṇaṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzñauṃ dzñauṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kha gā na ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kṣ+māṃ kṣ+māṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra bai gai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hāṃ hāṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hīṃ? hīṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shau ṇa ḍi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra warmi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ki li ki li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su bī rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si li si li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā ba le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hi li hi li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra bārti ni ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dhi li dhi li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā bīdyai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kā kā syāe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u lū kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwā nā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su ka rā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dā ḍī ṇi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū tri ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣṭi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma thā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ suṃ bha ni/ swa bhā wa/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas la sogs pa rnams ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba sa dang nam mkha' bar snang gang ba/ arghaṃ nas shapda'i bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sumbha ni/ swa bhā wa/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis mdun du rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa rtsegs pa'i steng du/ ri rab zur bzhi pa rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin rtse mo brgyad kyis mdzes pa'i steng du/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shu yod pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi rtsa ba'i stegs bu/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu la/ lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo'i steng du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang / 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/

byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ shar lhor nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ lho nub tu mun pa mi zad pa/ nub byang du kī li kī li'i sgra sgrogs pa'i dur khrod/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa rnams na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad ni/ shar du brgya byin/ byang du nor bdag nub tu chu lha/ lhor gshin rje/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shing brgyad ni/ shar du shi ri sha/ byang du a shwad tha/ nub tu kaṃ ka la/ lhor tsū ta/ shar lhor ka ran dza/ lho nub tu la ta parka ti/ nub byang du par ti pa ka byang shar du bha ḍa/ de dag la sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i zhing skyong shing lo'i gseb nas lus phyed thon pa/ gri thod 'dzin pa dang / klu chen po brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas/ byang du 'jog po/ nub tu stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor padma/ shar lhor hu lun ta/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du dung skyong / byang shar du padma chen po/ sprin brgyad ni/ shar du sgra grag pa/ byang du rmugs pa/ nub tu mun pa can/ lhor kun tu 'khyil pa/ shar lhor gang ba/ lho nub tu 'bab pa/ nub byang du drag po'i sprin gyi bdag po/ byang shar du 'khrigs pa'o/ /gzhan yang mchod rten brgyad/ chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ ri brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis gang ba/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis ro langs dang / 'byung po 'dus pa lce spyang gi sgra sgrog pas bskor ba dang bcas pas bskor ba'i nang gi lha snam/ shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser ba/ dbus ind+ra nī la'i sa gzhi la 'khor lo gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i lte ba la/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar dang /

sku lus la lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa phyogs bzhir g.yon skor gyis nas/ g.yas brkyang pas gnas pa'i bar dang / mtshams rnams su bum pa nas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i bar 'dra/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar gyi rtsibs su/ pū li rā ma la yar khaṇḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ byang gi rtsibs dzā lan dha rar mahā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub kyi rtsibs au ḍi ya nar/ kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho'i rtsibs ar bu tar/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang / rna chen ma/ shar lho'i rtsibs go da wa rir/ su ra wi ri dang / brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub kyi rtsibs ra me shwa rir/ 'od dpag med dang / mi'u thung ma/ nub byang gi rtsibs de wi ko ṭar/ rdo rje'i 'od dang / lam ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar gyi rtsibs ma la war/ rdo rje'i sku dang / shing grib ma ste thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog nag po rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar gyi rtsibs kā ma ru par/ aṃ ku ri dang / ai rā ba ti/ byang rtsibs o ṭer/ rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner/ dpa' bo chen po dang / rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sa lar/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma/ shar lho'i rtsibs ka ling kar/ rab bzang po dang / shyā ma de wi/ lho nub kyi rtsibs laṃ pa kar/ rdo rje bzang po dang / shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang gi rtsibs kan dzir/ 'jigs byed chen po dang / rta rna ma/ byang shar gyi rtsibs hi ma la yar/ mig mi bzang dang / bya gdong ma ste gsung gi 'khor lo/ kha dog dmar po padma'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir/ stobs po che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gri ha de bar/ rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇḍa ro he/ nub rtsibs sau rāṣṭ+rar/ rta mgrin dang / shoṇa ḍi ni/ lho rtsibs su barṇa dwī par/ nam mkha'i snying po dang /

'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho'i rtsibs na ga rar/ dpal he ru ka dang / shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub kyi rtsibs sindhur/ padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / stobs chen ma/ nub byang gi rtsibs ma ror/ rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor lo sgyur ma/ byang shar gyi rtsibs ku lu tar/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor ba thams cad kyang zhes pa nas/ phag mo lta bu'i bar 'dra/ 'og gi sa gzhir/ shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje bstan ma nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar dang / de rnams kyi gnas rnams su nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bar 'dra ba la/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ ji ltar sogs nas/ shrī hūm̐ gi bar dang / zhes gsungs zhing dbang bskur bas ye shes kyi chus lus gang nas/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan gyi bar dang / sngags mchod phyi mchod 'dra/ mjug tu/ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li ni pradzñā pā rā mi ta/ nā da swa bhā we/ badzra dharm+maḥhṛ da ya/ santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho hoḥ.aḥkhaṃ swāhā/ yid byung gi mchod pa ni/ oṃ bī ni badzri ṇi hūm̐ ā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni/ zhes pa kun la sbyar la/ bī nī badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ khaṃ se badzra ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ baṃ sya badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mṛ taṃ ga badzri ṇi hūm̐ ā/ oṃ mṛ taṃ ga badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ murdza badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ murdza badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hā sya badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ hā sya badzri ṇi badzra pū dze te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ lā sya badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ

oṃ lā sya badzri ṇi badzra pū dze te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gī ti badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ gī ti badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ nirti badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ nirti badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puṣpe badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ puṣpaṃ badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dhū paṃ badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ dhū paṃ badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dī paṃ badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ dī paṃ badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gan dhaṃ badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ gan dhaṃ badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ā darsha rū pa badzre ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ ā darsha rū pa badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ra sa badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ ra sa badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ parṣe badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ parṣe badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dharm+maḥdhā tu badzri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ oṃ dharm+maḥdhā tu badzri ṇi badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐// //bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra ratna badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bde bar༞ nor bu༞ bkren zhing 'phongs pa rgyun bcad de/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi ratna badzra pū dza/ btsun mo༞ ma rigs mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wa satṛ ratna badzra pū dzi/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ pu ru ṣa ratna badzra pū dzi/ glang po༞ lta ngan thams cad rab bsal nas/ /bla med theg la rab zhon te/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti ratna badzra pū dzi/ /rta mchog༞ srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog

/a shwa ratna badzra pū dzi/ dmag dpon༞ nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /'jigs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaḍga ratna badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog brtsal du gsol/ /sarba ta thā ga ta'i mthar/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /mos blos༞ bzhes༞ shapda kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang / /a kar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed pa/ /mos blos༞ bzhes༞ gaṇḍha kā ma gu ṇa/ phyogs dus kun nas ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos༞ bzhes༞ ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam nyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed pa/ /mos blos༞ bzhes༞ sparṣa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ nang mchod ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ ru sbal zhabs/ shrī dza lan dha ra/ nag po spyod pa/ gu hya pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ 'pham 'thing pa sku mched/ klog skya she rab rtsegs/ mal gyo blo gros grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ bla ma zhang dkon mchog dpal/ bla ma brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang rgyud man ngag thob pa/

sde snod gsum dang 'brel ba'i mdo gzhung 'grel pa thob pa'i dus gsum gyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi༞ dkon mchog gsum mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu khyad par can rnams kyi༞ bde mchog gi sngar gyi sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ rang gi chos skyong gi snying po'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing skyong ba'i bka' sdod srung ma rnams kyi༞ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro/ gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa/ yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'gro ba sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa rnams kyi༞ rgya gar/ rgya nag li yul/ bal po la sogs pa/ gnas khyad par can gyi rten dang / gtsug lag khang gi srung ma rnams kyi༞ bod kyi gtsug lag khang rnams dang / bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa khyad par can na gnas pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi༞ phyogs skyong bcu/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ rjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi༞ gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi༞ 'gro ba rigs drug lam brgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing / zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā kalpāgni sinni bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nas/ oṃ na mo badzra bā rā hi baṃ mahā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri khaṃ ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kyi bar sngar bzhin dang / rgyas par spro na/ rgyal ba sprul pa dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'jigs mdzad cing / /raṃ raṃ rnam 'khor utpal sngo 'dra nyi ma brgya yi gzi/ /rdo rje dang ni kha ṭwāṃ gar bcas oṃ oṃ dag par ldan/ /tshangs dang lha chen khyab 'jug mgo bcad dbu yi cod pan can/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ ha ha zhes bya khro ba dang bcas pa/ /mi yi seng ge dregs pa 'joms mdzad zhabs kyis gnon mdzad cing / /a la la yi sgra sgrogs bgegs rnams yongs su 'dar bar mdzad/ /cang te'u sgra sgrogs lha chen khyab 'jug dag gi lpags pa rnams/ /thugs rje cher sprul rab khros dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐ mdzad cing / /li kṣiṃ gau ri zhabs kyis gnon cing ku tsar rab tu bzhugs/ /lha rnams mgo la zhabs kyis mnan bzhugs bde gshegs dbu rgyan can/ /lha rnams kun gyi 'khor gyi 'khor los yongs bskor mdzad pa po/ /hu lu hu lu dziṃ dziṃ triṃ baṃ rgyu ma thod rlon gyi/ /phreng ba 'dzin cing rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'jigs shing khro ba yi/ /glu sgra mi bzad hu lu hu lus rab tu rmongs 'dzin cing / /rdo rje chen po mā ma kīs ni sku lus rnam par brgyan/ /dur khrod rab tu 'jigs shing gar gyis 'khor lo'i tshogs skrag mdzad/ /ka ha ka ha'i bzhad sgras gnod sbyin tshogs rnams skrag rengs mdzad/ /brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs shing bi bi sha nas sku lus brgyan/ /bskal pa grangs med rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dus kyi mthar yang ni/ /ha na ha na da ha da ha phaṭ kyis mdzad pa can/ /stong pa'i ngang las sku gsung thugs kyi sangs rgyas rnam par 'phro/ /phyin ci log zhen lta ngan mtha' dag ma lus med mdzad cing /

/gu lu gu lu dzaṃ dzaṃ yaṃ yaṃ gis ni zhi bar mdzad/ /nam mkha' dag dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin thugs ni rnam par smin/ /bde ba chen po khyod ni maṃ maṃ zhes ni mdzad pa can/ /sems can don du thugs rje chen po'i mdzad pa mdzad pa po/ /ā li kā li rab tu sbyor ba'i sdom pa gsang ba can/ bcom ldan mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig ma lus ston par mdzad pa yi/ /dpal chen he ru ka ni brtan g.yo'i bdag po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig he ru ka yi bstod pa 'di bsgoms bcom ldan phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /lha dang mi rnams gsang ba gsum bdag he ru yi gzugs 'dzin 'gyur/ /gtor ma ni/ byin gyis brlab pa nang mchod byin rlabs dang 'dra/ swa bhā was stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ/ raṃ/ baṃ/ laṃ/ suṃ/ hūm̐/ bhruṃ/ hūṃ/ baṃ/ laṃ/ maṃ/ paṃ/ tāṃ/ pū/ dza/ au/ a/ go/ rā/ de/ ma/ ka/ o/ tri/ ko/ ka/ la/ ka/ hi/ pre/ gri/ sau/ su/ na/ si/ ma/ ku/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar/ lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dmigs pa'i gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ dur khrod brgyad kyang yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad du gyur/ phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharm+maḥyo ga shuddho haṃ/ oṃ badzra a ra li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki ni/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dṛ shya ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rkang brgyad gnyis dang / lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin la/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag rnams/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /chos skyong gi gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ mdun du thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang / sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su dgra bgegs mnan pa'i steng du paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/

tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa gri gug g.yon thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis ka'i dbus na rnam sprul gyi gaṇḍī bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen la brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na lce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon trag las e ka dza ṭī sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ bhyo las dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lda'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/

snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang / g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid cing mi sdug ma/ lte ba'i thad nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na/ hūm̐ dang / bhyo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ lcam dral gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ mgon po lcam dral gnas 'dir gshegs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ mahā kā li de wi ye e hye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ gṛhṇe daṃ arghaṃ/ sogs nas shapda'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ mahā kā la de wi ye/ sa ma ya sma ra ye/ sa ma ye mā ti kra ma ye/ sa ma ye rakṣantu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ khyad par du bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dor bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tsham pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / bsdigs shing spa bkong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa dang /

'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya mahā kā li de wi ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo/ bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tad khaṃ ud ga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ gong ltar mchod/ oṃ shrī ma kā la shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇe/ e ṣā pishtsa ma kā lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ ratna trā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇi/ ya di pra ti dzña/ sma ra sita ta/ i daṃ duṣṭā kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ ban dha ban dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ ru ru ro ru bi tiṣṭha/ ba to si/ ka ma la/ rākṣa si/ hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐// //hūm̐ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum rtsegs 'jigs byed pa'i/ /gtum po khyed la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag gang snod/ /thod phreng can la bdag bstod do/ /khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsnyil/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā lā ya/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ /mahā de ba'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po mahā kā lā ya/ /'jigs byed chen po mahā kā lā ya/ /legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum rtsegs dgra/ /bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma nag po che/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra bla nag po che/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /'dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /sman rag phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da 'chol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por 'bul/

/'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams mang po/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las ni myur du sgrubs/ /zhes dang // //bhyo gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod kyi sku/ /ri rab lhun po lta bur brjid/ /dbang po sngon po lta bur 'bar/ /nyi ma'i zer ltar sprul pa 'gyed/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug /mi ro khar bcug mche ba gtsigs/ /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /'jigs pa'i mtshon chas phyag rnams brel/ /mi mgo rin chen rus pas spras/ /klu dbang seng ge lcags sgrog dang / /khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan/ /ko rlon re lde gos su gyon/ /bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo rgyu/ /shin tu rid cing mi gdug ma/ /'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra sgrogs pas/ /khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas/ /sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la 'dud/ /khyod thugs zhi la rab gzhol yang / /snying rje'i dbang gis srid la zhugs/ /khro dang 'khrug dang rngam pa yis/ /bdud dpung nges par 'joms la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /'dir gshegs sogs kyis bstod cing phrin las gzhol// //mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥpheṃ/ oṃ badzra ā ra lli ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥ oṃ kha kha/ kha hī kha hī/ sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa/ bhū tā/ pre ta/ pi shā tsi/ ud ma ra/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka/ ḍā kī n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa tu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhaṃ me pra yatstsha du ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣṭaṃ/ bhun dza tha/

dzi ghra tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ti kra mā tha/ ma ma sarb+ba kārta yā/ sad su khaṃ/ bi shuddha ye sa ha yi ka bha wantu huṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can gtum drag mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /srung mas rtag tu stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan rnams med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams rgyas shing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ //gzhi bdag gtor ma ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ādya nud panna twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /sbyin no/ gsol lo/ /bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// //zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ lag pa'i mthil du padma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar/ oṃ baṃ rdo rje 'phag mo dmar mo/ mdun nas g.yon skor gyis haṃ yoṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dmar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ skyod byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ tsaṇḍi ka dud kha thams cad kyang gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa/ sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i dbus dang sen mor zla ba'i gdan la/ mthe bor oṃ ha rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ mdzub mor na ma hi rnam par snang mdzad ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ gung mor swa hā hu padma gar dbang dmar po padma 'dzin pa/ srin lag bau ṣaṭa he dpal hai ru ka nag po rdo rje gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ ho rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser rin po che 'dzin pa/ bsdus pa'i dbus su phaṭ haṃ rta mchog ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa de rnams kyis yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan zhing / g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ u tsiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa si swāhā/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa thams cad tshim zhing dgyes par gyur cig/ //bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung zhing / /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/

/shes rab phag mo'i padma las ni rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog/ //smon lam ni/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ /he ru ka dpal de dang lhan cig gar byed shog /lha mo tshad ma la sogs/ mjug gi cho ga ni/ sngar bzhin phyi nang yid byung rkang brgyad gnyis kyis mchod/ yi ge brgya pa'i rjes su/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badzra muḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho haṃ/ gtor ma bstab pa ni/ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la dang / /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' lding bya khyi lce spyang 'khor dang bcas/ /pu tra la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs kyi rjes su/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod/ /sum bha ni/ oṃ ha sogs/ pū dza sogs// //nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nub mo chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang du nyal lo/

/ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ tho rangs nam mkha' las ḍā ma ru'i sgra yi ge bdun pa'i sngags su grags pas/ gnyid blang nas/ he ru ka'i skur langs la/ snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du lta'o/ /khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ dbang gi skabs ltar bya/ spyod lam ni/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad he ru ka brjod pa dang sgra grags pa rnams sngags/ rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul du bltas te shes par byas nas/ yul gyi lhas/ nang gi lha la mchod par bsam zhing / yul rnams la sdang zhen med par spyod do/ /tshul 'di las dang po pa rnams kyis bzung bde ba'i phyir/ ngag 'don rnams a wa dhū tī pa'i btsun pa bsod nams kyis zur du bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni/ dge slong mgon po rin chen zhes pas bgyis te/ go don rnams mtshan la yod pa bzhin legs par khong du chud par bya'o/ /mdun bskyed la sgra tshul las bskyed pa sogs yod na'ang / slob dpon dril bu zhabs kyi dgongs pa dkrong bskyed yin pa bzhin bla ma dam pa 'phags pas mdzad pa'i lugs su bkod pa'o// //dge'o// //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 18 bla ma dam pa/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i mngon rtogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 19
